normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 visible terminal-cell rows after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Every accepted row pins exact raw projected and rendered hashes plus one-based inclusive blank-column ranges.
policy: Fail-closed review of every production-debt phrase and every legacy BBS control/color-token match. Accept only spans proven by complete syntax-family, full-payload, and rendered-preview evidence to be unexpanded directives, runtime values, or generic numbered menu-template markers; retain completion metadata, attribution, functional labels, artist/group suffixes, leetspeak, binary or ASCII texture, authored text, and ambiguity.
